name: Young Volunteers at the Free Library of Philadelphia
what_you_do: Volunteer at Parkway Central Library or a neighborhood library. Teens shelve books, help with office tasks, or review books as a Teen Book Critic.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12. The library says all volunteers must be at least 14 years old.
duration: At least 1 to 3 hours a week for 2 to 3 months. Some seasonal and short-term roles are listed too.
how_to_apply: Print the Volunteer Application, fill it out, and email it to volunteer@freelibrary.org or mail it to Volunteer Services Program, 1901 Vine Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Staff then schedule an interview.
notes: The page asks for age 14 and up but also says grades 7 to 12, so younger 7th graders should call first. For a paid role, the library's LEAP after-school program hires Teen Leadership Assistants through Career Connected Learning PHL (C2L PHL). Questions: 215-686-5340.
